features.name: price_range
features.description: Measures the total price movement within the period by subtracting low from high.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows tree models to split on market volatility directly without needing to construct the relationship across multiple nodes.

features.name: relative_open_position
features.description: Calculates where the open price sits relative to the high-low range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of price position, helping trees identify trend direction and price momentum.

features.name: volume_per_trade
features.description: Average volume per trade, indicating the typical size of transactions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps trees distinguish between retail (many small trades) and institutional (few large trades) activity.

features.name: log_volume
features.description: Log-transformed volume to handle extreme outliers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in volume, allowing trees to make more balanced and robust splits across the distribution.

features.name: log_trade_count
features.description: Log-transformed trade count to handle right-skewed distributions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in trade count, improving split efficiency and preventing a few extreme values from dominating splits.

features.name: is_extreme_open
features.description: Indicator for open prices near the boundaries of 0 or 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct boolean split for markets that are highly confident in one outcome, which often exhibit different dynamics.

features.name: high_volume_low_trades
features.description: Indicator for markets with above-average volume but below-average trade count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly flags potential whale activity or block trades, providing a strong categorical split for tree models.

features.name: platform_1_indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows trees to isolate platform-specific behaviors without relying on ordinal splits of categorical IDs.

features.name: platform_2_indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows trees to isolate platform-specific behaviors without relying on ordinal splits of categorical IDs.

features.name: market_activity_level
features.description: Semantic assessment of market activity level based on volume and trade count, categorized into ordinal buckets (0=inactive, 1=low, 2=medium, 3=high).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean ordinal feature for trees to split on overall market engagement, abstracting away raw volume noise.

features.name: price_direction_momentum
features.description: Semantic assessment of implied price momentum based on the relationship between open, high, and low prices, scored from 0 to 10.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex non-linear price dynamics that might require multiple tree splits to approximate using raw features.

features.name: liquidity_profile
features.description: Semantic assessment of market liquidity based on the combination of volume, trade count, and price range, scored from 0 to 5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic view of market depth, helping trees identify markets prone to slippage or manipulation.
